    simpa +contextual [IH] using

theorem tendsto_round_nhdsGE_pure [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [OrderClosedTopology α] [ContinuousAdd α]
    (x : α) : Tendsto round (𝓝[≥] x) (pure (round x)) := by
  rw [funext round_eq']
  have hmul : Tendsto (2 * ·) (𝓝[≥] x) (𝓝[≥] (2 * x)) := by
    -- `simp` turns `2 * y` into `y + y`, so this is just `tendsto_add` + monotonicity of addition.
    simpa [two_mul] using
      ((tendsto_id.add tendsto_id).inf <|
        (tendsto_principal_principal.2 fun a ha => add_le_add ha ha))
  simpa using
    (tendsto_pure_pure (fun n => (n + 1) / 2) _).comp
      ((tendsto_floor_right_pure_floor (2 * x)).comp hmul)
